column16: Cat follows raccoon from window to window
Cat and dog stare at each other
Person doesn’t notice raccoon at all
Hot air balloon crosses directly in front
Worker has apparently been watching the entire climb
Entire skyline briefly celebrates the raccoon
Person holds up a sign: WHY?
Person holds up: GET A JOB.
Someone offers raccoon a tiny umbrella
Someone offers raccoon a tiny hat
A cat appears wearing a tiny crown
Raccoon sees another raccoon through two consecutive windows
Person takes a selfie and accidentally captures raccoon
Person starts filming raccoon with increasingly serious equipment
A squirrel appears to be racing the raccoon
A pigeon appears to be racing the raccoon
A completely unexplained enormous object slowly floats past
Someone screaming at a video game
Someone sees raccoon and slowly backs away
Someone holds up a newspaper with raccoon on front page
Someone’s face appears extremely close to glass
Window shakes followed by surprise scare (Boom)
